title: Slippery
text: Slippery. I love the softness of this rug, but it is too slippery and is an accident waiting to happen.  I love the color too - disappointed that due to slipping hazard, will not be able to use this.

product_metadata.title: OdentBlca Fluffy Area Rug for Bedroom 3x5,Soft Fuzzy Shaggy Rugs for Girls Bedroom,Fluffy Rug for Kids Room,Shaggy Carpet for Living Room with Non-Slip Bottom,Khaki Rug
features: FLUFFY RUG: The rug is made with a tie-dye process, a soft plush fibre surface and memory foam with a high pile density and a tight weave that doesn't shed, making this area rug feel cloud-like and light.

NON-SLIP BASE: The area rug is made with a hard-wearing dot-moulded base that grips the floor firmly to prevent sliding and is resistant to wear and tear, making it safer and more comfortable for your children or pets to sit and play on the rug.

SUITABLE FOR ANY ROOM: This range of rug is suitable for all indoor areas. Living room rugs, bedroom rugs, children's room rugs and more; a wide range of colours and sizes to choose from to match the decor and layout of your room.

RUG CLEANING INSTRUCTIONS: Shaking or using a low powered handheld hoover will easily remove dust from the surface of the rug. Spot clean- blot the stain with a damp cloth and a mild detergent. After air drying, it is best to fluff it up a little. Do not machine wash.

RUG PACKAGING NOTE: As this rug comes with a vacuum bag, it is normal to see that the pile on the rug is not fluffy enough and has creases. Please leave it flat for 2 to 3 days and wait patiently for it to recover.
